short: Pioneering constant-product AMM for permissionless token swaps and liquidity provision
introduction: Uniswap V2 is the foundational automated market maker that popularized the constant product formula (x * y = k) for decentralized token trading. Any ERC-20 token pair can be traded permissionlessly through dedicated pair contracts created by the factory. Despite being superseded by V3 and V4, Uniswap V2 remains widely used due to its simplicity and extensive integrations across DeFi.
designPurpose: Uniswap V2 was designed to provide a simple, trustless mechanism for on-chain token swaps without order books or centralized intermediaries. The constant product invariant ensures that liquidity is always available at some price, while the factory pattern allows anyone to create markets for any token pair. Its straightforward LP token model democratized market making for all participants.
commonUsage: Traders use Uniswap V2 to swap tokens directly on-chain with guaranteed execution. Liquidity providers deposit token pairs to earn a share of the 0.3% trading fee on every swap. Many protocols still fork or build on Uniswap V2's pair contracts for their own AMM implementations due to the well-audited, battle-tested codebase.
fn.swapExactTokensForTokens.desc: Swaps an exact amount of input tokens for as many output tokens as possible, routing through one or more intermediate pairs along the specified path.
fn.swapExactTokensForTokens.params.amoun: The exact amount of input tokens to swap.
The minimum output tokens to receive. Reverts if the actual output is less (slippage protection).
fn.swapExactTokensForTokens.params.path: An array of token addresses defining the swap route from input to output.
fn.swapExactTokensForTokens.params.to: The address to receive the output tokens.
fn.swapExactTokensForTokens.params.deadl: The Unix timestamp after which the transaction will revert (deadline protection).
fn.swapExactTokensForTokens.returns.amou: An array of amounts for each token in the path, showing input and output at each hop.
fn.addLiquidity.desc: Adds liquidity to a token pair, depositing both tokens proportionally and minting LP tokens to the provider.
fn.addLiquidity.params.tokenA: The address of the first token in the pair.
fn.addLiquidity.params.tokenB: The address of the second token in the pair.
fn.addLiquidity.params.amountADesired: The desired amount of token A to deposit.
fn.addLiquidity.params.amountBDesired: The desired amount of token B to deposit.
fn.addLiquidity.params.amountAMin: The minimum amount of token A to deposit (slippage protection).
fn.addLiquidity.params.amountBMin: The minimum amount of token B to deposit (slippage protection).
fn.addLiquidity.params.to: The address to receive the minted LP tokens.
fn.addLiquidity.params.deadline: The Unix timestamp deadline for the transaction.
fn.addLiquidity.returns.amountA: The actual amount of token A deposited.
fn.addLiquidity.returns.amountB: The actual amount of token B deposited.
fn.addLiquidity.returns.liquidity: The amount of LP tokens minted.
fn.removeLiquidity.desc: Burns LP tokens and withdraws both underlying tokens proportionally from the pair contract.
fn.removeLiquidity.params.tokenA: The address of the first token in the pair.
fn.removeLiquidity.params.tokenB: The address of the second token in the pair.
fn.removeLiquidity.params.liquidity: The amount of LP tokens to burn.
fn.removeLiquidity.params.amountAMin: The minimum amount of token A to receive.
fn.removeLiquidity.params.amountBMin: The minimum amount of token B to receive.
fn.removeLiquidity.params.to: The address to receive the withdrawn tokens.
fn.removeLiquidity.params.deadline: The Unix timestamp deadline for the transaction.
fn.removeLiquidity.returns.amountA: The actual amount of token A withdrawn.
fn.removeLiquidity.returns.amountB: The actual amount of token B withdrawn.
fn.getAmountsOut.desc: Calculates the output amounts for each hop along a swap path, given an exact input amount. Used for quoting prices off-chain.
fn.getAmountsOut.params.amountIn: The exact input amount for the first token in the path.
fn.getAmountsOut.params.path: An array of token addresses defining the swap route.
fn.getAmountsOut.returns.amounts: An array of amounts showing the output at each step of the path.
fn.getReserves.desc: Returns the current reserves of both tokens in the pair contract, plus the timestamp of the last update. This data is used to calculate swap prices.
fn.getReserves.returns.reserve0: The reserve amount of token0 in the pair.
fn.getReserves.returns.reserve1: The reserve amount of token1 in the pair.
fn.getReserves.returns.blockTimestampLas: The timestamp of the last reserve update, used for the TWAP oracle.
fn.Swap.desc: Emitted when a swap is executed in a pair contract, recording the input and output amounts for both tokens.
fn.Swap.params.sender: The address that initiated the swap (usually the router).
fn.Swap.params.amount0In: The amount of token0 sent into the pair.
fn.Swap.params.amount1In: The amount of token1 sent into the pair.
fn.Swap.params.amount0Out: The amount of token0 sent out of the pair.
fn.Swap.params.amount1Out: The amount of token1 sent out of the pair.
fn.Swap.params.to: The recipient address of the output tokens.
fn.Sync.desc: Emitted after every reserve update, recording the new reserve values. Used by off-chain systems to track pool state.
sim.tokenSwap.name: Token Swap
sim.tokenSwap.desc: Simulates a token swap through the Uniswap V2 Router, demonstrating the constant product formula and how reserves change.
sim.tokenSwap.step.callRouter: The trader calls swapExactTokensForTokens() on the Router, sending the input tokens along with slippage and deadline parameters.
sim.tokenSwap.step.routePair: The Router queries the Factory to look up the pair contract address, then forwards the swap to the correct pair.
sim.tokenSwap.step.constantProduct: The pair contract calculates the output using the constant product formula (x * y = k), updating reserves while maintaining the invariant.
sim.tokenSwap.step.receiveTokens: The output tokens are transferred from the pair contract to the trader. A 0.3% fee is retained in the pool for liquidity providers.
sim.addLiquidity.name: Add Liquidity
sim.addLiquidity.desc: Simulates adding liquidity to a Uniswap V2 pair, depositing both tokens and receiving LP tokens in return.
sim.addLiquidity.step.approveTokens: The liquidity provider approves the Router to spend both Token A and Token B.
sim.addLiquidity.step.callAddLiquidity: The provider calls addLiquidity() on the Router with desired and minimum amounts for both tokens.
sim.addLiquidity.step.transferToPair: The Router transfers both tokens from the provider to the pair contract in the correct proportion.
sim.addLiquidity.step.mintLP: The pair contract mints LP tokens proportional to the geometric mean of the deposited amounts relative to existing reserves.
compose.erc20.role: Each pair contract holds reserves of two ERC-20 tokens and mints its liquidity shares as an ERC-20 LP token (UNI-V2).
compose.erc2612.role: The LP token implements EIP-2612-style permit, so pool-token approvals can be granted by signature instead of a separate approve transaction.
compose.erc712.role: Permit approvals are signed as EIP-712 typed data against each pair's own domain separator, keeping meta-approvals wallet-readable and replay-safe.
